summary: Automate GitHub synchronization for reusable CI workflows

delivery.outcome: The GitHub sync CLI accepts an explicit repository and can restrict inbound reconciliation to Planfile-managed Issues without changing outbound ticket selection.
nonGoals: No workflow or release publication changes in this ticket.
No deletion or migration of existing GitHub Issues.
No credentials are persisted or derived from repository-local state.

architecture.decision: Keep repository selection as an explicit CLI override and pass managed Issue labels through the existing backend list_tickets protocol. The filter applies only to inbound reads; outbound local ticket selection remains unchanged.
interfaceChanges: Inbound sync passes optional labels to backend.list_tickets().
architecture.rollback: Revert the CLI options and label plumbing; existing config-driven sync remains available.

validation.evidence: The help output exposes the explicit repository binding.
The fake backend records the managed label filter and outbound behavior remains unchanged.

commands: ruff check planfile/cli/groups/sync/commands.py planfile/cli/groups/sync/core.py planfile/sync/operations.py tests/test_sync_managed_only.py
